# Daniel Blake // Software Engineer

> Personal website of Daniel Blake, a software engineer based in Portland, Oregon. A single-page static site with an introduction, skills summary, and links to professional profiles.

Daniel has spent almost a decade building high-quality websites and frontend experiences, and has grown a strong interest in backend foundations and working with data. Daniel builds accessible, responsive, and fast websites with a user-first approach. Daniel is currently looking for a role as a Web Developer, Frontend Developer, Design Engineer, or Full-stack Developer, and is open to remote, hybrid, and on-site positions.

Core skills: React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Astro.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js.

- [Home](https://danielblake.dev): Introduction, about section, skills, availability for work, and contact links.
